Generation Experiments and Evaluation
|-- Pin the evidence and generation contract
|   |-- CompareSessionService.capture(sources) -> independent canvas copies
|   |   |-- Source identity = documentId + optional viewId + checkpointId
|   |   |-- Deduplicate identical sources; reject changed workspace heads or saved views
|   |   `-- copyCompareHistory -> selected checkpoint + required diagram revisions
|   |       |-- New history context; baseline and head both point to selected checkpoint
|   |       |-- Empty past/future; omit checkpoint parent and transaction links
|   |       `-- Preserve rendering dependencies without copying the undo archive
|   |-- EvalPromptService.resolve(promptId, version, workflow) -> pinned prompt
|   |   |-- Stage bodies + template base + content hash + derivation/parent versions
|   |   |-- Cited reference names, ASCII and comments frozen into the run
|   |   `-- Authoring and version control
|   |       |-- Validate stage variables, section tags and reference IDs
|   |       |-- Save against expected base version; retain previous versions
|   |       |-- Revision / fork / merge / relaunch lineage must be acyclic
|   |       `-- Defaults become explicit saved text; execution substitutes visible variables
|   `-- EvalRunService.prepare -> EvalRun
|       |-- Request/hash, project, workflow, model, effort and selected prompts
|       |-- Canvas inputs, optional canvas set, prior alternatives and layout template
|       |-- AgentContext pins = ID + name + contentHash
|       |   |-- Resolve model-visible evidence at execution; reject a changed hash
|       |   `-- Canvas-only workflows create an owning context from inputs and prompts
|       |-- Cells normally keyed by prompt + pass + stage; initially queued
|       `-- Reruns reuse matching pinned inputs and remain under the original run/context
|-- ExperimentService: organize cases, conditions, phases, samples and comparisons
|   |-- save(design) -> revisioned experiment with prepared runs
|   |   |-- Check case context hashes and existing output project/context/cell identities
|   |   |-- Map every planned generation cell exactly once to a sample stage
|   |   |-- prepareForReview captures prompts and inputs without launching generation
|   |   `-- generationReview = awaiting-approval; prepared run snapshots retained
|   |-- approve(expectedRevision, requestId)
|   |   |-- Persist approval receipt and starting state before launching
|   |   |-- launchPrepared for each unstarted run; persist started IDs after each launch
|   |   `-- Attach run/cell references to sample stages -> review status started
|   |       `-- Approved plans, samples and inputs cannot be reassigned
|   `-- relaunch(sample, stage, edited stages)
|       |-- Validate edits and preserve the original layout-input contract
|       |-- Fork an immutable prompt version with relaunch lineage
|       `-- Record another attempt under the same phase/case/condition/sample number
|           `-- Request receipts make repeated launch requests reusable or conflicting
|-- EvalRunService: launch and execute pinned runs
|   |-- start(request) / launchPrepared(prepared)
|   |   |-- Same request ID + same hash -> reuse; different hash -> conflict
|   |   |-- Save queued run before background execution
|   |   `-- Track live run and AbortController; serialize progress snapshots per run
|   |-- Scheduling
|   |   |-- Independent prompt/sample chains; default concurrency = 3
|   |   |-- Session-delivered AgentContext -> one chain at a time
|   |   `-- Sample count does not change prompt variables: pass = passes = 1
|   |-- generateValidated: compose prompt -> runtime -> validate/materialize
|   |   |-- Valid output -> result + accumulated usage + execution metadata
|   |   |-- Invalid output -> retry with previous-output.json + validation-error.json
|   |   |   `-- At most 3 generation attempts; original prompt and input files retained
|   |   `-- Runtime failure or exhausted validation -> cell failure; abort -> cancellation
|   |-- Runtime boundary: AgentContextEvalRuntime.generate
|   |   |-- No AgentContext snapshot -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   `-- Snapshot supplied -> independent persisted Pi session
|   |       |-- Resolve source references before opening session
|   |       |-- No tools, extensions, skills, context files, compaction or runtime retries
|   |       |-- Shared prefix cache key includes model, effort, system prompt and context hash
|   |       |   `-- Distinct session IDs + SSE keep sample answers independent
|   |       |-- Prompt + supplementary files -> assistant text -> JSON when parseable
|   |       |   `-- Malformed JSON reaches the workflow validation retry above
|   |       `-- Timeout/abort supported; always remove listeners and dispose session
|   |-- Workflow dispatch from evalWorkflows
|   |   |-- alternatives: saved AgentContext -> one canvas per prompt/sample
|   |   |   |-- Optional pinned previous-N.json files provide selected earlier alternatives
|   |   |   `-- Layout supplied -> template materializer; otherwise alternative materializer
|   |   |-- roll-up: pinned child + parent -> r2 -> g2
|   |   |   |-- r2: compress child -> materializeRollUp -> save generated canvas
|   |   |   |   `-- If r2 fails, mark g2 skipped
|   |   |   `-- g2: validated r2.json + pinned parent -> materializeAttachment
|   |   |       |-- a: edges only; b: parent edits without merges; c: merge into parent
|   |   |       |-- Consume each r2 diagram exactly once by placement or merge
|   |   |       |-- Require an attachment edge and preserve parent positions
|   |   |       `-- Fork parent view, reanchor edited edges, add edges, save attached view
|   |   |-- linked-canvases: context.json + canvases.json -> frozen canvas-set result
|   |   |   `-- materializeLinkedCanvases validates the entire graph in memory
|   |   |       |-- Existing canvas -> copy baseline, apply edits, reanchor edges
|   |   |       |-- New canvas -> materialize diagrams with namespaced IDs
|   |   |       |-- Include every input canvas exactly once; require a valid root
|   |   |       |-- Validate cross-canvas text spans, diagram targets and target concepts
|   |   |       |-- Every canvas must be reachable from root through directed jumps
|   |   |       `-- Replace old jump lists -> proposed canvases + revisions + placements
|   |   |-- diagram-change-proposal: pinned context -> proposal tree -> generated canvas
|   |   |   `-- Keep tree syntax errors intact for deterministic assessment
|   |   |-- few-shot-refinement: one prompt, pinned target and one titled layout slot
|   |   |   |-- Seed five synthetic references
|   |   |   |-- Three rounds, each generating and evaluating three alternatives
|   |   |   `-- Refine references and retain one progress Judgement
|   |   `-- diagram-history: plan -> serial execution over preceding pinned canvas sets
|   |       `-- External history runner owns launch/resume; ordinary prepare rejects it
|   `-- Output storage
|       |-- step() -> generated representation in project catalog
|       |   |-- Retain prompt, workflow, run, sample, context and optional layout provenance
|       |   `-- Pin output checkpoint/history and placement snapshot; mark cell finished
|       |-- Linked canvas sets -> run.outputResults[cellKey], with a summary on the cell
|       `-- captureOutputResult -> pin a completed change-session proposal
|           |-- Require matching project, session ID and expected version
|           |-- Same captured version is reusable; a different existing output conflicts
|           `-- Capture does not accept the proposal or start generation
|-- Compare and assess retained outputs
|   |-- CompareSessionService.createPinned -> session over captured copies
|   |   |-- Diagram pairs validate revision, line ranges and optional subtree scope
|   |   |-- Canvas pairs retain camera/focus information
|   |   `-- Later source changes do not replace the selected evidence
|   |-- JudgementService reconciles comparison sessions and generation jobs
|   |   |-- Typed records: diagram-comparison, canvas-comparison, comparison-report
|   |   |-- Evaluator = manual or model; subjects link source checkpoints to run/cell IDs
|   |   `-- Retain result data, copied canvases, status, usage and source fingerprint
|   |-- Native results share the Judgement store
|   |   |-- few-shot-progress -> schema-validated round progress
|   |   `-- diagram-change-tree -> deterministic result with request fingerprint
|   `-- ExperimentService.judge(comparison)
|       |-- Select phase/case/condition outputs; require finished proposal cells
|       |-- judgeDiagramChangeTrees over exact retained proposal text
|       `-- Save subjects with canvas/checkpoint evidence and attach Judgement to comparison
|           `-- Judgement subjects must fit that comparison; one experiment owns it
|-- Promote a completed output into published project work
|   |-- promotionSource(runId, cellKey) chooses retained evidence
|   |   |-- History artifact -> timeline step result
|   |   |-- Pinned outputResults entry -> cloned result
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> generated canvas at the cell's checkpoint
|   |-- promoteOutput(request)
|   |   |-- Prior request ID + matching signature -> return existing receipt
|   |   |-- Existing-canvas destination must be settled and at expected revision
|   |   |   `-- Reject generated/projection destinations and unsaved workspace edits
|   |   |-- New-project destination creates a canvas-project group
|   |   `-- prepareOutputPromotion -> projectCatalogs.publishOutputPromotion
|   |       `-- Publish documents with request signature and run/cell placement provenance
|   `-- Historical placement backfill
|       `-- Completed run + matching original whole-canvas promotion -> lineage receipt
`-- Retain lifecycle and compatibility boundaries
    |-- Server restart -> fail interrupted ordinary run cells; retain completed canvases
    |   `-- Interrupted eval-run Judgements fail while retaining completed rounds
    |-- Cancel -> abort active generation; history and legacy runs use their own paths
    |-- Delete run -> abort, drain writes, archive generated canvases, save tombstone
    |   |-- Deleted runs cannot be written back by late progress saves
    |   `-- Single-run deletion includes reruns; selected batch deletion keeps unselected runs
    |-- Delete context outputs -> remove workflow runs/comparisons/canvases; keep context
    `-- LegacyGenerationAdapter bridges chat-generated alternatives into eval records
        |-- recordLegacy reconciles chat lifecycle; replay/cancel use retained chat executor
        `-- Migration preserves pinned checkpoints and does not resurrect archived outputs
